name: Continue to Stormwind
label: Quest
description: You carry a requisition from Sentinel Hill to Stormwind by gryphon, where Osric Strang awaits in Old Town.

clips.title: The story
paras: You carry a requisition from Sentinel Hill to Stormwind by gryphon, where Osric Strang awaits in Old Town.

Quartermaster Lewis prepares a requisition note in Sentinel Hill. The local gryphon master Thor offers you the fastest way out of the contested plains. For a modest fee, you ride one of the kingdom's trained gryphons above dusty farmlands and the river border of Elwynn Forest, then over Stormwind City's high white ramparts.

After you land at the capital's trade roosts, you head into Old Town to find Osric Strang at his shop, Limited Immunity. Osric supplies the frontier, but his grim reception shows the growing rift between Westfall's beleaguered People's Militia and the distracted rulers in Stormwind Keep.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Lewis' note to Osric. You won't get there faster any other way.
If that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride. I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've been traveling, eh? Have you been anywhere interesting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a note from Quartermaster Lewis? I'm not surprised he needs more gear. Sentinel Hill is far away, in a land Stormwind has all but forgotten.
Well thank you, friend. Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
